text: Residents have reached out to me with concerns about speeding on Boulton Avenue between First Avenue and Dundas Avenue. We received a petition from local residents with 53 percent support. In a subsequent confidential ballot, there was 86 percent support from affected households. For the sake of public safety, I am supportive of the installation of speed humps on this street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (five speed humps) on Boulton Avenue, between First Avenue and Dundas Street East, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 7, 2026) from Councillor Paula Fletcher.
